description: We are EarthByte AI, an independent team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our interests include AI/ML, Python, data science, Earth observation and NASA open data. We aim to build a practical solution using NASA resources. We welcome developers, data analysts, designers and researchers interested in collaborating. Skills sought: Python, AI/ML, data analysis, web development and Earth science.
summary: EarthPulse is an interactive prototype that explores how Earth science data can be experienced through sound as well as visuals. Designed for NASA's Earth Information Jukebox challenge, it aims to connect Earth Information Center visualizations with sonified data, allowing users to hear patterns and changes in our planet. By combining visual information with audio, EarthPulse explores a more engaging and accessible way to communicate Earth science, including for people who may have difficulty interpreting visualizations alone.
details:
EarthPulse — Hear Our Changing Planet

EarthPulse is an interactive, browser-based sonification prototype created for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the Earth Information Jukebox challenge.

The project explores how environmental information can be experienced through both visuals and sound. It displays an illustrative environmental time series and converts changing numerical values into audible sine-wave frequencies. Higher values produce higher-pitched tones, while lower values produce lower-pitched tones.

Users can explore the demonstration through Play Sonification, Stop, Next Sample, and volume controls. A visual chart, numerical values, and corresponding sounds work together to help users understand patterns in changing environmental information.

The main goal is to explore more accessible and engaging science
